# Astro Kaal Chakra

> Astro Kaal Chakra is an Indian online astrology platform: users chat, call or video with verified Vedic astrologers about love, marriage, career, finance and health, paying per minute from a prepaid wallet (first chat is free for new users). It also offers free astrology tools — Janam Kundli, Kundli Matching (Guna Milan), daily Panchang, horoscopes, numerology and a zodiac sign finder. Available in English and Hindi, on the web and as a mobile app.

Operated by Sparkroot Technologies Private Limited, India. Support: support@astrokaalchakra.com, +91 92510 64637.

## Consult an astrologer

- [Talk to an astrologer](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/astrologers): Browse verified astrologers by language, specialty, rating and per-minute price; see who is online and start a chat, call or video session.
- [Live sessions](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/live): Free live astrology streams by astrologers.
- [How it works](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/how-it-works): Choosing an astrologer, recharging the wallet, per-minute billing, the free first chat and the waitlist.

## Free astrology tools

- [Free Kundli (birth chart)](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/kundli): Janam Kundli with North and South Indian charts, planetary positions and Vimshottari Dasha.
- [Kundli Matching](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/kundli-matching): Ashtakoot Guna Milan (36 gunas) and Manglik check for marriage compatibility.
- [Today's Panchang](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/panchang): Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise/sunset and Rahu Kaal for any city in India.
- [Horoscope](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/horoscope): Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly horoscopes for all 12 zodiac signs.
- [Numerology Calculator](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/numerology): Life path, destiny and other core numbers.
- [Zodiac Sign Finder](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/zodiac-sign-finder): Sun and moon sign from date of birth.
- [Astrology reports](https://www.astrokaalchakra.com/reports): Detailed written reports.
